# drip

> Free, open-source macOS CLI (MIT). drip shows a native card from your Mac's notch, or the top of a screen without one, when a command or coding agent finishes or needs you. It is not Notification Center, so it needs no permissions. macOS 13+. Install: `brew install jrnxf/tap/drip`.

## Docs

- [README: install, usage, flags, config](https://github.com/jrnxf/drip#readme)
- [Claude Code, Codex and Gemini CLI notifications](https://drip.jrnxf.co/claude-code-notifications)
- [Alert when a command finishes](https://drip.jrnxf.co/notify-when-command-finishes)
- [Compared with terminal-notifier, osascript, alerter](https://drip.jrnxf.co/vs)
